LanguageData.WotF_Adamantine.description: A dark-gold metal that feels cold and heavy to the touch and will not burn. Exceptionally hard and dense, whether raised into fortifications or forged into heavy armor and weapons, it is exceedingly difficult to break.
LanguageData.WotF_Adamantine.label: adamantine
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenSteel.description: A pale blue-silver metal transmuted from steel and livingwood through ritual. Light yet tough, it takes an exceptionally keen edge, swings far more nimbly than ordinary steel, and lends itself well to forging both staves and blades.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenSteel.label: elven steel
LanguageData.WotF_LivingWood.description: A wondrous length of wood, supple and alive to the touch. The moment you bring it into contact with mana, a soft green glow blooms through it from the inside out.
LanguageData.WotF_LivingWood.label: livingwood
LanguageData.WotF_Mithril.description: A moon-white metal that feels almost weightless and never burns. Mana clings to it readily: weapons and armor forged from mithril gain an extra spell-inscribing slot and draw less mana when triggering inscribed spells.
LanguageData.WotF_Mithril.label: mithril
